items.stem: Search quality suddenly drops after a deploy. You find queries are embedded with model A but the documents were indexed with model B. Why does this break search?

options.text: Vectors from different models live in different spaces, so distances between them are meaningless
options.rationale: Correct: query and document embeddings must come from the same model to be comparable.

options.text: Model B is always worse than model A
options.rationale: The issue is incompatibility, not that one model is worse.

options.text: The database ran out of disk
options.rationale: This is a space-mismatch problem, not storage.
The metric is fine; the inputs are incomparable.

items.explanation: Correct: query and document embeddings must come from the same model to be comparable.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about approximate nearest-neighbour (ANN) indexes are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: They trade some recall for much faster search at scale
options.rationale: Correct: ANN accepts occasional misses to gain speed.

options.text: They may not return the exact true nearest neighbours every time
options.rationale: Correct: results are approximate by design.

options.text: They guarantee perfect recall like exact search
options.rationale: That is exact search, not approximate.

options.text: They remove the need to choose a distance metric
options.rationale: A distance metric is still required.

items.explanation: Correct: ANN accepts occasional misses to gain speed.

items.stem: Why use metadata filtering alongside vector similarity in a multi-tenant store?

options.text: To restrict similarity search to one tenant's or one category's vectors so results are both relevant and correctly scoped
options.rationale: Correct: metadata filters enforce scoping and tenancy on top of similarity.
Filtering complements, not replaces, vector search.

options.text: To make the index smaller on disk
options.rationale: Metadata adds data; it is for scoping, not compression.

options.text: To avoid needing an embedding model
options.rationale: Embeddings are still required for similarity.

items.explanation: Correct: metadata filters enforce scoping and tenancy on top of similarity.
